items.title: TreVeyon Henderson: Not spotted at Monday's practice
items.description:
Henderson (ankle) was not spotted at the portion of Monday's practice open to the media, according to Mark Daniels of MassLive.com.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Jonathon Brooks: Works out off to side Monday
items.description:
Brooks (general soreness) was spotted working out of to the side during Monday's practice, Mike Kaye of ESPN.com reports.

items.title: Michael Penix: Will be inactive for season opener
items.description:
Falcons head coach Kevin Stefanski said that Penix (knee) will be inactive for Sunday's season opener in Pittsburgh, Marc Raimondi of ESPN.com reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Michael Penix: Won't start in Week 1
items.description:
Penix (knee) won't start the season opener Sunday in Pittsburgh, after the Falcons named Tua Tagovailoa their top quarterback heading into Week 1, Will McFadden and Tori McElhaney of the team's official site reports.

        Visit RotoWire

items.title: Tua Tagovailoa: Will start Week 1
items.description:
The Falcons will have Tagovailoa start at quarterback in Sunday's season opener against the Steelers, Tom Pelissero of Netflix reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.
